description: Abstract class for managing entity query subscriptions, including dynamic value resolution, subscription handling, and update mechanisms within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbAbstractEntityQuerySubCtx
classes.description: Abstract class managing entity query subscriptions with dynamic value resolution and update handling.

classes.name: DynamicValueKey
classes.description: Key class for identifying dynamic values based on predicate type, source type, and attribute.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch data based on the query.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Abstract method to update the subscription state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the subscription context, cancels tasks, and clears subscriptions.

methods.name: setAndResolveQuery
methods.description: Sets the query and resolves dynamic values.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves dynamic values for entities based on tenant, customer, and user IDs.

methods.name: dynamicValueSubUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates from telemetry subscriptions and updates dynamic values accordingly.

methods.name: updateDynamicValuesByKey
methods.description: Updates dynamic values based on the latest TsValue.

methods.name: registerDynamicValues
methods.description: Registers dynamic values from key filter predicates.

methods.name: getDynamicValueFromSimplePredicate
methods.description: Extracts dynamic value from simple predicate if user value is null.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Returns the latest TsValue from a list based on timestamp.
